rules.title: SwiftUI first
rules.text: Build new UI in SwiftUI with small composable views.

rules.title: Observation framework
rules.text: Use @Observable and @State/@Bindable appropriately; keep views free of business logic.

rules.title: Swift concurrency
rules.text: Use async/await and actors instead of completion handlers and manual locks.

rules.title: No force unwraps
rules.text: Avoid force unwraps and force try; handle optionals with guard let.

rules.title: Prefer value types
rules.text: Prefer structs and enums over classes unless identity is needed.

rules.title: Avoid retain cycles
rules.text: Use [weak self] in escaping closures that may outlive the owner.

rules.title: MainActor for UI
rules.text: Mark UI-touching code @MainActor and keep heavy work off the main thread.
